rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name plus zip, matched to a single user. They inspected the user’s orders and located the delivered order containing both the water bottle and desk lamp. They checked product variant availability via tools and presented valid options. Before making any changes, the agent clearly summarized the requested exchanges and sought explicit confirmation. When the user limited the request to only the desk lamp, the agent reconfirmed and then executed only that exchange with the correct item IDs, order ID, and payment method. The tool confirmed the exchange request and price difference, which the agent reported accurately. No actions were taken without confirmation, no cross-account actions occurred, and no unsupported or fabricated details were introduced. All steps align with policy.
